newsitem.title: UK: BoE's George- Stg rise much to do with politics.
newsitem.headline: BoE's George- Stg rise much to do with politics.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Wednesday the strength of sterling and the dollar against European currencies had as much to do with politics as economics.

"If you look at the timing of the uptrends in both sterling and the dollar against the core European currencies, they are mostly concerned with developments in politics, not economics," George told parliament's Treasury select committee.
The currency markets have been rocked to and fro by speculation over the line-up of countries who will join a European single currency's first wave.
A broad line-up could entail softening of the entry criteria and has led to fears of an unstable currency block. Britain retains an opt-out from European monetary union.
